name: Cape Conran Coastal Park

facts.claim: Coastal park on Victoria's far-east Wilderness Coast, near Marlo in East Gippsland, about 420 km east of Melbourne
Wild ocean beaches for beachcombing, with whales migrating past from May to October
East Cape Boardwalk has interpretive signs on the Aboriginal history of the Cape
Yeerung Gorge has deep rock pools fed by the East Yeerung River; Banksia Bluff is the main campground

name: Mitchell River National Park

facts.claim: Jointly managed park in Gippsland on Brabralung Country, significant to Gunaikurnai Traditional Owners
Rainforest gully walk to the Den of Nargun, with a loop to the Mitchell River for summer swimming and a lookout
Billy Goat Bend has a lookout over the Mitchell River Gorge and rapids, with picnic tables and camping
Mitchell River Walking Track links Angusvale and the Den of Nargun; the river has Grade III-IV whitewater, best July to December

name: Den of Nargun

facts.claim: Cave behind a waterfall in a rainforest gully of Mitchell River National Park, reached by a loop walk from a picnic area
Tradition says the Nargun, a being half human and half stone, lives there; Gunaikurnai people and Parks Victoria ask visitors not to enter the cave
The loop continues to Deadcock Den, where Eastern Water Dragons sun themselves, and a lookout over the loop and park, with river access for a swim in warmer months

name: Sovereign Hill

facts.claim: Open-air museum in Golden Point, Ballarat, depicting the first ten years after gold was discovered there in 1851
Visitors can pan for real gold, wander an 1850s township and go on an underground mine tour
More than twenty experiences are included in general admission, with live characters and craft workshops

name: Eureka Stockade

facts.claim: Eureka Stockade Memorial Park in Ballarat is considered the site of the 1854 Eureka Stockade rebellion
The park has significant trees, interpretive plaques and monuments honouring those involved
The Battle of the Eureka Stockade was fought on 3 December 1854; the official toll was 27 deaths
